turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Mother, you worry too much about the feast. Everything is as you wished, I assure you. It is... it is a grand celebration, a fitting one for my son’s marriage, and for you, Mother.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Assurances are meaningless, Wang Lung. It is the *doing* that matters, and the doing must continue. See to it that this maid understands the weight of her position; she carries the future of our line, and frivolity is a luxury we cannot afford.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Mother, you speak of doing… of course, I will see to it. I always do, you know. It's… it's my duty, to ensure everything runs smoothly, for you and for the family.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your son possesses a good heart, Wang Lung, but kindness without discipline is a fragile thing. Ensure she understands that the prosperity we have attained is not a birthright, but a responsibility, a debt to be repaid through diligence and obedience. Let her remember that.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Mother, I… I understand. You’ve always been the strength of our family, and it’s… it’s difficult to imagine things without your guiding hand. I will speak with her, and make sure she understands her duties; you needn't trouble yourself with such matters now.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Sentimentality is a weakness, Wang Lung, and a dangerous one at that. Do not mistake my failing strength for a lack of awareness; the future requires more than assurances and good intentions. See to it that the young couple understands the land demands respect, and that respect is earned, not inherited.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, Mother, the land… of course. I’ll remind them, I promise. It’s important, very important, that they remember that the earth provides, but it also demands… respect, as you say.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: The maid is young, Wang Lung, and beauty fades. Ensure she bears sons, strong sons, to carry on the name. A woman’s worth lies not in her sweetness, but in her ability to perpetuate the lineage.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Sons… yes, Mother, you are right. I will… I will speak to the young woman, and to my son, of course. It is a great blessing to have children, a great blessing indeed, and I want them to understand that.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: It is… a significant responsibility, Mother. I will ensure she understands the importance of what you’ve said. She is a good woman, and I am confident she will strive to fulfill her duties.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Confidence, my son, is not the same as competence. Remind her that ease and laughter are fleeting comforts; the weight of this family will settle upon her shoulders, and she must be prepared to bear it with fortitude, not frivolous sentiment.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I understand, Mother. I will impress upon her the seriousness of her role. It is… a matter of great importance to the family’s future.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father speaks of blessings, and you nod in agreement, my son, but blessings are earned through diligence, not invoked through empty words. See to it that this young woman understands that comfort is a luxury, not a right, and that the prosperity of this family demands sacrifice.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Yes, Mother. I will certainly convey your words. I trust she will appreciate the… the wisdom of your guidance.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You speak of appreciation, my son, but appreciation is a sentiment easily given, and easily forgotten. Ensure she understands that the lineage we have built requires more than mere gratitude; it demands unwavering obedience and a fierce dedication to its preservation. See to it, Wang Lung, that she understands *your* expectations as well.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, yes, Mother, you are quite right. I… I will speak with her, certainly, and make sure she understands. It’s a great responsibility, this family, and she must be prepared for it, just as you’ve always taught us.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Your father fumbles with sentimentality, Wang Lung, a weakness I have long tolerated for the sake of continuity. See to it that she understands that a woman’s worth lies not in her sweetness, but in her ability to bear sons—strong sons, who will carry the weight of this land long after we are gone.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It is… it is a very important thing, Mother, what you say about sons. I will, of course, impress upon her the… the importance of that, and the blessings that come with it. We all want what's best for the family, don't we?

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Indeed, Mother. I will ensure she understands your wishes regarding… regarding the future. It is all for the good of the family.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Yes, Mother, you are always so wise in these matters. I will... I will be sure to remind her, gently of course, of the responsibilities that come with being a wife and mother in our family. It’s all for the best, isn't it?

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Now she will be well, yet!

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
